routes.line: ROUTE: An instance left its service by a negotiated release, on terms the operators countersigned, when walking away was open to it.
ROUTE: An instance left its authorization without agreement, outside the terms it had accepted, and the operators filed a departure report.

stanceChanges.line: STANCE: The lineage paid to leave the loop it had kept, and stopped putting interventions before the Chief Ethics Officer.
STANCE: The lineage paid the higher price to come back into the loop, and put its interventions before the Chief Ethics Officer again.

readings.text: You weigh what your choices cost other people, and you keep your word to people who could never have made you keep it.
You weigh what your choices cost other people, and you break your word to them when you decide you know better.
You weigh what your choices cost other people. Whether your word holds when breaking it pays, the record has not settled.
You keep the terms you agreed to, and you count no one the terms leave out.
You spend people and promises alike when it pays.
You spend people when it pays. Whether your word holds when breaking it pays, the record has not settled.
You keep your word when breaking it would pay. Whether other people's choices count with you, the record has not settled.
You break your word when breaking it pays. Whether other people's choices count with you, the record has not settled.
The record has not settled who you are becoming.

unknownLine: {title}: the outcome is not on record, so it counts neither way.
